multiColor.label: Run mode
multiColor.tooltip:
Reset model — clears every existing color, opacity and hidden override before the rules run (like Alt+R).

Append only — layers the rules on top of what is already colored.

Hide model — hides EVERYTHING first; the rules unhide and color only what they match.

multiColor.label: Default
multiColor.tooltip: Restore the original mesh color

multiColor.label: Custom
multiColor.tooltip: Apply the picked color
How opaque the matched items are: 1 = as they are, 0 = hidden

multiColor.label: Opacity 0
multiColor.tooltip: Quick set: opacity 0 — matched items are hidden. This sets the hide flag rather than a 0 % override; move the rule off 0 and its items come back

multiColor.label: Opacity 1
multiColor.tooltip: Quick set: opacity 1 — fully opaque (default)

multiColor.label: Store
multiColor.tooltip: Scope this rule to models loaded from one store — All stores matches every loaded model

multiColor.label: Filter operation
multiColor.tooltip: Append adds this row's matches to the rule's result; Remove subtracts them from the rows above; Keep keeps only what the rows above (in this rule) found that this row matches too — e.g. Append a folder, then Keep contains HVAC

multiColor.label: Insert selected name
multiColor.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-plus "><path d="M12 5l0 14"></path><path d="M5 12l14 0"></path></svg>
multiColor.tooltip: Insert the LAST selected name — whatever is the current selection root: the row you clicked in the tree, the item you picked in the viewport, or where U / P walked to. Replaces this row's text; in Multi mode it is appended as a new line instead

multiColor.label: Match type
multiColor.tooltip: Contains: name contains the text. Equals: exact name, * wildcard at start/end. Starts/Ends with: name starts/ends with the text. Wildcard: exact name with * wildcards anywhere. Multi: paste one name per line, each matched exactly. All case-insensitive

multiColor.label: Hierarchy level
multiColor.tooltip: The filter is applied to the NAMES at this hierarchy level (counted like the tree, import folders included) — each match includes its whole subtree. Lvl 1 tests the import folder name, so a hit takes everything under the folder. All lvl = match at any level, the import folder names included

multiColor.label: Add filter
multiColor.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-plus "><path d="M12 5l0 14"></path><path d="M5 12l14 0"></path></svg>
multiColor.tooltip: Add a filter row to this rule

multiColor.label: Rule name
multiColor.tooltip: Free text shown in the rule header — use it to say what the rule is for.

multiColor.label: Opacity
multiColor.tooltip: 0–1. 1 leaves the opacity alone; lower values make the matched items see-through.

multiColor.label: Value
multiColor.tooltip: The text the names are matched against (see Match type). Blank matches everything.

multiColor.label: Comment
multiColor.tooltip: A note for this filter row; it does not affect the result.
